welcome_title: You are warmly welcome to our wedding!
location_body: The wedding takes place in the heart of Lund, Sweden. We'll begin with a ceremony in Kulturens trädgård, so please arrive in good time before we start at 15:00. If the weather is nice we'll be outdoors, but keep in mind that it can be chilly. Afterwards we'll walk together to Tegnérs matsalar to continue the celebration. It's about a three-minute walk between the two.
location_tip: Tip: As a wedding guest, you have free entry to Kulturen from 12:00 if you'd like to visit the museum before the ceremony.
dress_body: Come dressed in a way you feel comfortable in. Examples:
dress_avoid: Please avoid solid black or white dresses.
speeches_body1: Many of our friends and family are talented musicians and gifted speakers. The venue has a stage, and we warmly encourage speeches, music, and other performances.
speeches_body2: For speeches, please feel free to keep them fairly short so that we have time to listen to everyone who would like to speak. A maximum of three minutes is usually about right.
speeches_body3: We'd like all speeches to be sent by email to our toastmasters by 1 March 2027. In the email, please include your name and the full text of your speech in the language you'll be speaking.
speeches_body4: This is because ours is an international wedding. So that every guest can follow along, our toastmasters will translate the speeches into Swedish, Icelandic, English and German.
speeches_body5: Please also let our toastmasters know if you're planning to play music or perform in some other way during the evening. If you're performing a song and would like the lyrics translated so everyone can understand, you're welcome to send those in too.
speeches_body6: We're also planning an “open stage” during parts of the evening, where spontaneous performances can happen.
toastmasters_body: Our dear toastmasters will be putting together the programme of speeches and performances for the evening.
language_body: Our wedding will be international, with 4+ languages! We'll do our best to make everyone feel included throughout the day. That said, it's worth knowing that the ceremony will be held in Swedish.
gifts_body1: Your being there is what we wish for most, and it is more than enough.
gifts_body2: If you'd still like to give a gift, we'd be glad for something simple, something artistic, something consumable, or a contribution to our honeymoon to Italy.
rsvp_section_body: Please let us know whether you can join us by 3 February 2027. Use your personal QR code/URL to open the RSVP form at the bottom of the page. We love your four-legged family members, but please leave them at home on the day.
contact_body: If you have any questions before the day, you're welcome to reach any of us.
